name: get_daily_briefing
description: Rosa's day at a glance: today's medications and which doses are already logged, appointments in the next 10 days with prep, refill alerts, and today's home readings. Call this at the start of every conversation and for 'what do I have today'.

name: search_records
description: Search the text of Rosa's uploaded health documents (pharmacy medication list, lab report, after-visit summaries, appointment letters, insurance benefits, health summary). Returns the best matching excerpts with the document name and date. Use for any question about what a document or doctor said.

q.description: Short keyword query in English, e.g. 'pink pill', 'advil eliquis', 'fasting blood test', 'specialist copay'.

name: read_document
description: Read one full document from Rosa's records. Use when an excerpt is not enough, e.g. the whole lab report. Use 'list' to see all documents.

id.description: Document id or a word from its title, e.g. 'lab', 'medication', 'insurance', 'chen', 'appointments'.

name: get_medications
description: Rosa's medications with dose, what each pill looks like, what it is for, refills left, when it runs out, and which doses were taken today.

name: log_dose
description: Record that Rosa took her medication. Use when she says she took a pill or her morning/evening pills.

medication.description: Medication name or description ('Eliquis', 'the pink pill'), or 'all' for every pill due at that time.

name: get_appointments
description: Rosa's appointments with date, time, address, how to prepare, and questions saved for the doctor. 'past' returns past visit summaries.

name: add_question_for_doctor
description: Save a question Rosa wants to ask at an upcoming appointment, so it is on her list when she gets there.

appointment.description: Which appointment: 'next', a doctor name, or a type like 'heart doctor' or 'eye exam'.

question.description: The question in Rosa's words, in English.

name: analyze_lab_trend
description: Analyze how one of Rosa's lab values has changed over time (runs in a secure Daytona sandbox). Returns first and latest values, change, direction and whether it is at goal.

test.description: Which measurement. a1c = average blood sugar.

name: log_home_reading
description: Save a reading Rosa took at home (blood pressure, blood sugar, weight, heart rate). Returns whether it is in range and what her care plan says to do.

value.description: The value as she said it, e.g. '142/88', '118', '157'.

name: request_refill
description: Send a refill request for one of Rosa's prescriptions to Harbor Pharmacy (and to the prescribing doctor if no refills are left). Only call after Rosa says yes.

medication.description: Medication name or description, e.g. 'Eliquis' or 'the pink pill'.

name: notify_family
description: Text Rosa's daughter Ana. Use after an action (refill, saved question, worrying reading), when Rosa asks, or with urgency 'urgent' in any emergency.

message.description: Short message to Ana in English, written by cuida about her mom.
